title: Our Meetup chapter.
intro: The conversations continue. This archive preserves our original Meetup group and event history. Upcoming gatherings and registration are now on Luma.
historyIntro: Original event records, newest first. RSVP counts are the numbers shown by Meetup, not verified attendance.
limitationsBody: Public group and event content only. Individual member and attendee rosters are not republished. No public event comments were exposed during capture. Original descriptions are preserved in their original language; dates use the event’s recorded timezone.
eventNotice: This is a historical record, not an event invitation. For current gatherings, visit our Luma calendar.
cancelledNotice: Meetup marked this event as cancelled. It is preserved here as part of the historical record.
exportNote: The archive is stored with this website, including local copies of the images. No Meetup account is needed to browse it.
